Description.name: Epic Dwumrohl
Description.description: Everything's a drum! Everything's a drum! Epic Dwumrohl is the proof you didn't know you needed for the old adage: one Mon's trash is another Mon's treasure. With a drum kit assembled from the kind of doodads and doodlebugs you'd find strewn in a garden, even the insectoid Epic Wublin itself seems perfectly at home down at ground level.
